_description: CCNL Edilizia Industria ANCE (CNEL F012), impiegato di 2a categoria at level 5, April 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the tranche of 1 March 2026.
_notes: Row 'Imp. 2 cat. liv. 5' of the ANCE Ragusa table of 1 March 2026: retribuzione base mensile 1.676,02, indennità di contingenza 523,35, E.D.R. 10,33.
The base is the national minimo of level V from 1 March 2026 (ANCE table of the CCNL of 21 February 2025); contingenza and EDR are the bundle's fixed allowances (533.68).
The premio di produzione (245,51, provincial) is not modelled: the period gross is not pinned.
